There is minimal bony expansion of the mass, but FD may have obvious bone expansion. However, this typical radiographic finding is not histologically confirmed. The right image shows a native, axial scan of CT brain.

parathyroides | Adénome parathyroïdien |.description: A single parathyroid adenoma lesion (marked with arrows labeled 'PTA') is seen in the Ga-68-Trivehexin PET MIP (maximum intensity projection) and a PET/CT axial slice though the lesion. The same patient was diagnosed using the imaging agent Tc-99m-Sestamibi, which is standard-of-care for PHTH diagnostics. In the present case, the PTA is not seen on planar scintigraphy or SPECT/CT images. A moderate physiological uptake of Tc-99m-Sestamibi is observed in the healthy thyroid.
